capabilities: Play music tracks from a vault folder in a persistent sidebar panel
Trigger one-shot sound effects and looping ambience from searchable pickers
Crossfade music and fade loops in and out over a configurable duration
Set master, music, SFX and loop volume levels
Embed music, SFX, loop, scene and fade-out buttons in notes via codeblocks
extras: Scene volume presets change the saved Music and Loop sliders, so they stay in effect until the sliders are moved or another scene sets them; all audio must be stored in the vault.
problem: Playing background music, sound effects and ambience during a session inside Obsidian means juggling separate audio files with no shared volume, fading or scene control.
summary: Sidebar audio player for folder-based music, one-shot sound effects and looping ambience, with crossfades and note-embedded audio buttons.
